definitions.classes: unclear: max displacement < 1.0 m; timing_turn: along-chord displacement >= perpendicular displacement; else vertical share of perpendicular displacement >= 0.7 -> vertical, <= 0.3 -> lateral, otherwise mixed
definitions.deviation: displacement of the attacker from the SAME policy's no-defender trajectory (identical scenario) > 1.0 m; a trajectory divergence > 1e-4 m marks the first observation difference (the defender entering the 25 m gate)
definitions.labels: descriptive only; never used for reward
definitions.passes_ahead: attacker lies in front of the defender velocity vector at the closest approach (False: behind it); undefined when the defender moves < 0.5 m/s
definitions.reacquisition: first decision at/after the closest approach whose executed direction is within 10.0 deg of the line of sight to the asset
